intent_contract.text: 시각 의미 데이터와 후보팩에 반영해줘. 그 다음 독립된 서브에이전트 5개에서 각각 서로 다른 컨셉으로 반영한 키워드가 이미지에 실제로 반영되는지까지 테스트할 수 있는 랜덤한 복잡한 컨셉을 정하여 테스트케이스를 마련하고 첨부한 이미지를 활용하여 프롬프트 작성하고 이미지 생성하도록 하여 잘 반영되었는지 테스트해줘.
Test Anthrobot as a microscopic motile biobot assembled from adult human tracheal cells, not as a miniature humanoid machine.

Create a photorealistic science-feature photograph in a midnight orbital wet laboratory. An unmistakably adult biologist derived from the supplied portrait’s oval face, brown eyes, and long dark wavy hair leans toward a live microscope station, adjusting a fine-focus control. Beside her, a large calibrated monitor shows the magnified experiment: several microscopic, irregular multicellular spheroids made of living human airway tissue, each fringed with fine motile cilia, traveling across a scratched neural-tissue culture inside a microfluidic chamber. The organisms have cellular textures and asymmetric rounded forms. The physical petri-scale chamber, microscope optics, and magnified monitor establish the scale relationship. Cool instrument light brushes her face while Earthlight enters through the orbital window; floating droplets and tethered sample cartridges add depth. Use an environmental portrait with a clear inset-like monitor view, sharp scientific detail, restrained color, and believable laboratory optics.
